Requirement: The system shall display a login form with Email address and Password fields and a Login button.
The system shall display "Please fill out this field." when the user clicks Login with the Email address field empty (Chrome)
The system shall display "Please fill out this field." when the user clicks Login with the Password field empty. (Chrome)
The system shall display "Logged in as [username]" in the header after a successful login.
The system shall display "Your email or password is incorrect!" when the user clicks Login with unregistered email.
The system shall display "Your email or password is incorrect!" when the user clicks Login with wrong Password.
The system shall log in a user only when the entered email exactly matches a registered email address.
The system shall display a Logout button in the header after the user logs in successfully.
The system shall display the login form if the user clicks Logout button
The system shall remove "Logged in as [username]" in the header if the user clicks Logout.
The system shall log in a registered user who enters the email with different capitalization (e.g., LARA.QA01@MAILINATOR.COM) and the correct password.
The system shall remove spaces before and after the entered email and log in a registered user who enters the correct password.
The system shall display "Please enter a valid email address." and not continue with signup when the user enters an email address without a domain extension (e.g., test@gmail).
The system shall display "Email Address already exist!" when the user enters an Email address that is already registered.

The system shall pre-fill the Email field on the "Enter Account Information" page with the email entered on the Signup form.
The system shall not allow the user to edit the Email field on the "Enter Account Information" page.
The system shall pre-fill the Name field on the "Enter Account Information" page with the Name entered on the Signup form.
The system shall allow the user to edit the Name field on the "Enter Account Information" page.
The system shall mark the following fields as required: Name, Email, Password, First name, Last name, Address, Country, State, City, Zipcode, Mobile Number.
The system shall display "Please fill out this field." and not create the account when the user clicks Create Account with any required field empty. (Chrome)

The system shall display "Password must be 8–20 characters and include at least one letter and one number." and not create the account when the user enters a password shorter than 8 characters.

Requirement: The system shall display a pop-up message "Added! Your product has been added to cart." with a View Cart link and Continue Shopping button when the user clicks Add to cart.
The system shall display the columns: Item, Description, Price, Quantity, Total for each product on the Shopping Cart page.
The system shall increase the quantity of a product in the Cart by 1 when the user clicks Add to cart again for the same product.
The system shall display the value of Price * Quantity (e.g., Price = Rs. 500 and Quantity = 3, Total shall be Rs. 1500 ) in the Total column for each product row.
The system shall delete the product when the user clicks the X(delete) button for that product.
The system shall display "Cart is empty! Click here to buy products." when the user removes all the products in the Shopping Cart page.
The system shall display the Checkout page with the Address Details section when the logged-in user clicks Proceed To Checkout.

The system shall display a "Checkout" pop-up with the message "Register / Login account to proceed on checkout.", a Register / Login link and a Continue On Cart button when the guest user clicks Proceed to Checkout.
The system shall display "Maximum quantity per product is 10." and not add the product to cart when the user enters a quantity more than 10 in product details page and clicks Add to cart.
The system shall not add the product to cart when the user enters a quantity of 0 or less on the product details page and clicks Add to cart.
The system shall add the product to the cart with the entered quantity when the user enters a quantity between 1 and 10 on the product details page and clicks Add to cart.
The system shall display the quantity on the Shopping Cart page as read-only.
The system shall display an "Out of Stock" label on the Products page and the product details page when a product is out of stock.
Source: Confirmed by PO (RQ-01, RQ-09). Not testable now: no out-of-stock products available.

Requirement: The system shall disable the Add to cart button when a product is out-of-stock.
Source: Confirmed by PO (RQ-01) Not testable now: no out-of-stock products available.

The system shall display the inputs for Name on Card, Card Number, CVC, Expiration and a Pay and Confirm Order button in the Payment page.
The system shall display the total amount that matches the sum of the total of each product row on the page.
The system shall treat the following fields as required: Name on Card, Card Number, CVC, Expiration.
The system shall display "Please fill out this field." when the user clicks Pay and Confirm Order with any required field empty. (Chrome)
The system shall display "Your order has been placed successfully!" when the user clicks Pay and Confirm Order with all required field filled in.
The system shall display "Order Placed!", "Congratulations! Your order has been confirmed!", a Download Invoice button and a Continue button after the order is placed successfully.
The system shall download a file named invoice.txt when the user clicks Download Invoice.
The system shall display Home page when the user clicks Continue on the "Order Placed!" page.
The invoice shall contain the customer's name.
The invoice shall show a total purchase amount equal to the order total on the Checkout page.
